title: bee-write-guard resolveWriteRecord fix is uncommitted in main checkout
detail: Fixed a real bug in /home/vantt/projects/passMan/.bee/bin/lib/guards.mjs (resolveWriteRecord): an unbound session in a linked worktree had its gate checks silently fall back to main's unrelated default state.json. Fix applied there and synced into this worktree's own .bee/bin copy, but main's guards.mjs still has this fix as an UNCOMMITTED change (part of a larger ~4000-line uncommitted bee upgrade already sitting in main). Other linked worktrees (qr-handoff, passchef-mobile, passchef-mobile-android-keystore) each have their OWN separate .bee/bin copy and will hit the identical bug until this fix is synced into each of them too, or main commits the upgrade and each worktree re-syncs. See docs/history/learnings/20260728-passchef-mobile-oauth-sheets.md for full root cause.
